task_description: Build a complete Solana copy trading web application as a pnpm monorepo with 8 backend microservices, Next.js 15 frontend, custom Anchor on-chain vault program, PostgreSQL + Redis infrastructure, Docker Compose setup, and GitHub Actions CI/CD. The platform uses an on-chain vault pattern for non-custodial automated trading without per-trade wallet signatures.

verification.summary: pnpm build: 13/13 packages successful. pnpm test: 117 tests passing across 9 test files (risk-engine: 10, api-gateway: 47, vault-sdk: 20, tx-parser: 7, copy-engine: 10, execution: 5, analytics: 18). Docker compose YAML validates. GitHub Actions YAML validates. All tests exercise real logic with dependency injection and would fail if code is reverted.
